##### Project general facts

Bay Residences is an exceptional waterfront development that captures the very best of island living, blending elegant residential design with the beauty of the Arabian Gulf. Rising gracefully with sweeping ocean views, the project offers a refined collection of homes designed for those who appreciate sophistication, comfort, and a true sense of tranquility. Every element of Bay Residences has been thoughtfully created to deliver a lifestyle where relaxation, luxury, and natural beauty come together in perfect harmony.

Residents of Bay Residences are welcomed into a world of outstanding amenities, from dazzling swimming pools and inviting sun-loungers to scenic promenades, cycling paths, and dedicated running tracks that encourage an active, healthy lifestyle. The development offers a wonderful array of leisure experiences, including soothing spa treatments, vibrant souq-style retail stalls, and an inspiring selection of restaurants and bars for every taste and occasion. With beautifully landscaped surroundings and thoughtfully designed shared spaces, Bay Residences ensures every day feels like an indulgent getaway.

Inside, Bay Residences showcases beautifully appointed interiors finished with elegant marble flooring, sleek contemporary fittings, and a soft, sophisticated palette that exudes calm luxury. Expansive floor-to-ceiling windows flood each home with natural light while framing spectacular views of the sparkling waters beyond, creating a seamless connection between indoor comfort and the outdoors. Every finish and detail has been curated with care, delivering interiors that are as stylish as they are serene, perfect for those who expect nothing less than the finest quality of living.

##### Location description and benefits 

Mina Al Arab is a waterfront community in Ras Al Khaimah. It is situated along the shoreline, surrounded by wetlands and beaches. This is a community for individuals who desire to live near the ocean. Mina Al Arab is an idyllic twin-island destination with a prime location, just off the coast of central Ras Al Khaimah.

Mina Al Arab has been developed keeping in mind the natural surroundings, with a keen focus on preserving the natural wetlands and dunes that surround the community. The area attracts various marine life species which in turn attracts many tourists to the area. There are various trails within the community, which have been constructed for those who love hiking and biking through trails. The community is ideally located alongside Sheikh Muhammad Bin Salem Road.

Appealing to aspirational travellers and residents alike, the two manmade islands, which are beautifully landscaped, feature a marina, waterfront cafés and boutiques, and even a running track, as well as high-end resorts and residences with a range of world-class facilities, from spas to restaurants.
